NOTE
**Still not ready: the description doesn't compare this PR with the ones already in review**

New: The author updated the description, with no new push. It now has a "Relationship to other work" section and a self-review checklist that matches the template. Missing: that section only says the code was written independently. It doesn't say how this PR differs from #38098 and #39481 (both already in maintainer review with Niloth-p) or why another PR is needed, which is what the continuing-unfinished-work guide asks for.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave it unassigned until the author explains how this differs from the PRs already in review.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the description and fixing the checklist, @HeetRanpura. The new section says you worked independently, but not how this PR compares to #38098 and #39481 (both already in review) or why it should proceed instead of them. Please add that comparison, following the [guidelines on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html).
```
